context: Border city, 95%+ Hispanic, closer to Monterrey than San Antonio. Lucha country (Penta's home). Hendry's culture test. Fatu's first Raw appearance.

segments.outcome: Pre-taped package. Dark room war council. Roman + Usos. 'The first family' — fourth-wall camera look. Hard cut to Fatu.
segments.notes: Worked-shoot register; meta-kayfabe obligation activated. Power-position opener = Roman is THE program.

segments.outcome: Seth in all black, said his piece. Heyman silent — passed mic to Bron. Bron: 'You got nothing... I needed him [Heyman].' Seth granted Backlash match. Crowd singing for Seth.
segments.notes: Heyman silence diagnostic — testing Bron solo or keeping powder dry. Bron admitting dependence while mocking isolation. Seth is the granter, not the requester — agency with the lone wolf.

segments.outcome: Raquel cheap shot on Vaquer backstage. Liv leading. Full JD women's faction wipeout on Vaquer.
segments.notes: Legit AC sprain — written off indefinitely.

segments.outcome: Penta + Je'Von vs opponents (TBD from recap). Match transitioned to Page + Rusev staredown ringside.
segments.notes: Hulk Hogan 'Real American' desk promo aside — pharmacy giving itself medicine.

segments.outcome: Chad Gable fully gone — this is OG El Grande Americano now. Rey backstage, calling him 'Mr OG Grande Americano'.
segments.notes: Rey overcasting the character shift. Selling it too hard.

segments.outcome: Becky goaded IYO via Rhea-history wound; IYO attacked, Becky slipped out, Pearce made it a match. Becky wins — Asuka interference robbed IYO.
segments.notes: Nemesis controlled the full sequence. Asuka interference set up Backlash collision.

segments.outcome: Hendry concert — solid Laredo pop. Song morphed to 'Paul, Paul, can we fire Logan Paul'. Drew out Logan + Theory; 2-on-1 beatdown. Profits made the save. ~75% crowd singalong.
segments.notes: Orphic proof in border city. The instrument travels. Profits + Hendry alliance forming.

segments.outcome: Rey def. Kaiser-El-Grande-Americano via 619 after OG Gable intervened to stop Kaiser using metal plate.
segments.notes: Double-corrective — lucha cemented in WWE; lucha's inclusivity correcting institutional exclusion. Mask checks commitment, not ethnicity.

segments.outcome: Oba squashed Waller (who'd complained about no opportunities). Open challenge on the mic post-match. 'Anyone who wants to climb the mountain can step up.'
segments.notes: Ascending orisha breaks silence with generosity, not rage. Sovereign behavior — the mountain doesn't chase you, but invites.

segments.outcome: IYO + Asuka promo — Backlash match made official.
segments.notes: The Onryō who robbed IYO in S6 now gets the formal collision. Self-correcting pressure venues.

segments.outcome: Backstage: Liv 'my little Roxy' / Finn warns Roxanne. Match: Bayley + Lyra vs Raquel + Roxanne. Liv distraction at ringside, Roxanne capitalized for the win.
segments.notes: Three layers of manipulation. Roxanne the hinge. JD coven functional short-term despite fracture seeds.

segments.outcome: Roman closer. OTC chants. 'I run this place.' Couldn't finish saying 'nepotism' — Fatu cut it off physically. Mandible claw on Roman, choked him down. Picked up belt, threw it at Roman. 'I'm not waiting till Backlash — I'll see you next week on Monday.' Roman gave the match. Roman ended genuinely shook.
segments.notes: Roman owns BOTH power positions but lost sovereignty by close. Fatu violated the architecture. Belt rejected — wants the throne, not the accessory. Tongan Death Grip first deployed against Roman.
